propositions: The completion verifier reads a stale ticket snapshot because close_precheck pins the ticket store with fetch=False, which skips origin/tickets and uses the main repo's local refs/heads/tickets mirror that only advances on fetch.
The completion verifier's fenced context comes from the live store while the model's show_ticket call reads a pinned snapshot, causing the two halves of the gate to read different ticket states.
A FAIL verdict with no findings triggers synthesis of a fabricated placeholder criterion (unspecified) instead of reporting a verifier fault with verdict_obtainable=false.

Two independent tickets (cb91 and d4c2) were blocked by stale snapshot reads: one falsely reported zero comments and status=open, the other starved on evidence search for comments invisible in the stale pin.
